profile.name: Abiali Doctor
profile.headline: From interface to API, I build web applications.
profile.intro: I'm a full-stack developer based in Surat, India. I build web applications with JavaScript and TypeScript, from React and Next.js interfaces to Node.js APIs, databases, and cloud deployments.
story: I'm Abiali, a full-stack developer based in Surat. My work spans responsive websites and applications with connected customer, business, and admin workflows.

My earlier projects include a wedding marketplace, a reservation platform, employee marketing tools, and a wellness platform. On Wedfield, I worked across the customer site, vendor platform, admin console, and backend, including messaging, payments, invitation tools, and mobile apps built with Capacitor.

I work with React and Next.js on the frontend and Node.js, Express, and databases on the backend. My experience also includes API integrations, real-time communication, file storage, and AWS deployments. I continue learning through official documentation, courses, and hands-on projects.
